name: std/table
description: Mutable open-addressed maps for hot text-keyed lookup paths. Values are shallow-copied into backend-owned storage.
readme: Mutable open-addressed maps for hot text-keyed lookup paths. Values are shallow-copied into backend-owned storage.
Import this module with use table.

files.content:
-- Mutable open-addressed maps for hot text-keyed lookup paths.
-- Values are shallow-copied into backend-owned storage.
public define Table as opaque.
public use "table" function create[V]() giving failable pointer to Table.
public use "table" function put[V](collection pointer to Table, key text, value V) giving failable nothing.
public use "table" function get[V](collection pointer to Table, key text) giving failable V.
public use "table" function contains[V](collection pointer to Table, key text) giving failable boolean.
public use "table" function remove[V](collection pointer to Table, key text) giving failable boolean.
public use "table" function length[V](collection pointer to Table) giving failable unsigned.
public use "table" function close[V](collection pointer to Table) giving failable nothing.
